meta.title: About us
meta.description: We are a team that combines software development and cybersecurity. Learn about our mission, our values and how we work.

hero.title: Software engineering with a security mindset
hero.lead: We build software and subject it to the same tests an attacker would apply. We believe trust is earned through verifiable facts.

story.title: Security is not something you add at the end
paragraphs: Too much software is built first and protected later. The outcome is familiar: emergency patches, avoidable breaches and teams that learn about security when it is already too late.
DaeTrym was born to change that order. We design and build with security as a requirement from day one and, separately, we test systems — ours or other people’s — with independent judgment.

Our conviction is simple: secure software is software that is well thought out, well built and well explained. That is why we value clear code, documented decisions and reports that anyone can understand.

security.title: Security as a foundation

honesty.title: Technical honesty
honesty.text: We say what we know and what we do not. If something is a bad idea, we explain why.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: Less jargon, more explanation. A good report can be understood without a translator.

responsibility.title: Responsibility

ethics.title: Ethics
ethics.text: We only test what we are authorized to test and we protect the information entrusted to us.

learning.text: The threat landscape changes; so does the way we work.
